goal: Confirm whether Melchizedek is the Pre-Nobunaga Veil Throne operator
body: Dave recalled the missing operator as an Old Testament M-name figure viewed in Christian theology as a precursor/type of Jesus. Strongest match: Melchizedek. Deep grep already found raw canon shard 21407@db7 'Canon Decision: The Pre-Nobunaga Throne Operator' with Vacancy Paradox / Rule 2 Vacancy Collapse, but the exposed snippet truncates before the operator name. Please grep local dav1d/rhea vault source, especially page 2eeca671-311e-818d-87b9-dabceb8ff03a and any raw transcript backing shard 21407. Done when exact name, role, accession/succession mechanics, dates/era, and any Melchizedek wording are returned with provenance. Do not canon-lock the guess unless source text confirms it.
resolution: Captured as shard 25181@db1. Melchizedek pre-Nobunaga Veil Throne investigation acknowledged.
